description: SRUP - Aeroportos e Aeródromos is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Service and Public Utility Restriction (SRUP) - Airports and Aerodromes, in force in mainland Portugal. Airports and Aerodromes, including facilities to support aviation, constitute a servitude and restriction of public utility, being included in the scope of infrastructure. The constitution of aeronautical easements follows the regime provided for in the applicable legislation. Coverage: Direção-Geral do Território. The portal shows the English title as "SRUP - Airports and Aerodromes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral do Território. Its keywords include planeamento-e-cadastro, point, cartografia-oficial, srup, em-vigor, infomapaccessservice. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
